articles.title: A Sub-1-Point Gap: Why the BJP's Rajasthan Sweep Isn't the Mandate It Claims
articles.description: The BJP's success in Rajasthan's urban local body elections appears significant with 4,179 wards won against Congress's 3,613. However, this victory is marred by a slim vote margin of just 0.94 percentage points.

articles.title: U.S. House Advances Russia Sanctions Bill: Is India Facing 100% Tariff Risk?
articles.description: The U.S. House has advanced a key Russia sanctions bill that could give President Donald Trump the power to impose tariffs of up to 100% on countries buying Russian oil. India could face additional tariff pressure if the legislation becomes law. The bill has cleared a procedural hurdle in the House after a narrow vote and now moves towards a final House vote. India Today Global Editor, Pranay Upadhyaya explains what the proposed sanctions bill means for India, the next steps in the US legislative process, and the potential implications for India-US trade relations and ongoing tariff negotiations.

articles.title: Supreme Court refuses to reconstitute panel probing police excesses against student protesters
articles.description: The Supreme Court declined to alter the high-powered committee examining police actions. Objections against committee members were deemed based on conjecture and preconceived notions. The court directed the committee to proceed with its examination of allegations. Vulnerable witnesses will receive due protection and their identities kept confidential. Senior Advocate Monika Gusain will represent the committee as an independent arbiter.

articles.title: This NATO leader warns a Russian win could drag all of Europe into Putin’s war | Merz, Germany, Kyiv
articles.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz defended Germany’s foreign and security policy commitments while facing political pressure at home, saying Germany’s security cannot be separated from the fate of Europe. Speaking at the European Arctic Summit in Rovaniemi, Finland, Merz pointed to the attempted drone attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport on August 4, which the German government has blamed on Russia. Berlin says its security assessment found Russian involvement in the incident, while Moscow has rejected the accusations. Germany subsequently announced measures including the closure of Russia’s Consulate General in Bonn and restrictions affecting the Russian House cultural centre in Berlin.

articles.title: Kamala Harris HELPED Trump Win 2024? Ex-Democrat Insider 'EXPOSES' Ex-Veep's Biden 'CHARADE'
articles.description: Did Kamala Harris’ political maneuvering inadvertently help Donald Trump win the 2024 presidential election? A former Democratic insider is now making explosive claims about what happened behind the scenes before Joe Biden dropped out of the race. Lindy Li, a former Democratic National Committee fundraiser, claims Harris was privately courting Biden’s donors days before his withdrawal while publicly insisting there was “no daylight” between herself and Biden. Li alleges Harris was preparing for the possibility of replacing Biden even as she told major donors she would support him until the end.
